# **PRD: AI Concierge \+ Human Sales (SSD) Integration**

**Authors:** [Alex Liu](mailto:aliu2@linkedin.com) [Ed Munoz](mailto:edmunoz@linkedin.com)

**Status:** Under review | **Last Update: Mar 19, 2026** 

**Design link: [https://vca-ai-concierge.vercel.app/premium](https://vca-ai-concierge.vercel.app/premium)**

## **1\. Executive Summary**

LinkedIn currently uses an AI Concierge (VCA) to assist users during the Premium discovery phase. This project aims to evolve the AI concierge into a sophisticated sales engine that seamlessly differentiates between support needs, online self-serve purchases, and high-value enterprise leads, routing them to human sales development reps (SSD) or field sales (AE) only when necessary.

## **2\. Problem Statement**

Despite having an AI presence, the current user experience suffers from two primary friction points:

1. **Support-Induced Churn:** When a user asks a support-related question (e.g., "How do I cancel my current plan?"), the VCA redirects them to an external Help Center page. This pulls the user out of the sales funnel, leading to high drop-off rates.  
2. **Inefficient Lead Tiering:** We lack a robust mechanism to distinguish between a standard "Pro" user and a high-value "Enterprise" prospect. High-value leads are often left to self-serve, while low-value leads may clog up human support channels if they have minor questions.  
3. **Lack of Persistent Context & High Interaction Latency:** The current AI treats every interaction as a "first-time" encounter. It does not ingest the user’s historical chat data, recent platform activity (e.g., reaching search limits), or previous survey responses. This forces users into a repetitive "Discovery Loop," where they must re-state their goals. This high **Time-to-Recommendation (TTR)** creates friction and leads to drop-offs before the user even sees a SKU.

## **3\. Product Vision & Goals**

**Vision:** To create a "Concierge-to-Closing" flow where AI handles 90% of intent-matching and simple sales, while human experts are reserved for high-propensity "last mile" conversions and enterprise deals.

* **Primary Goal:** Increase Premium conversion via personalized, in-chat SKU recommendations.  
* **Secondary Goal:** Reduce sales rep "noise" by qualifying leads via AI before routing.

## **4\. User Flow & Logic** 

1. **Entry:** User clicks AI concierge  bubble on Survey/Chooser page.  
2. **Classification:** AI determines intent.  
   * *Support:* Answered inline (Phase 1).  
   * *Sales:* Proceed to **Sales Lead Classification Check.**  
3. **Routing:**  
   * **Field Qualified:** High-value/Enterprise lead → Route to **SD/AE** based on lead score.  
   * **Online Qualified:** Standard Premium lead → **Product Recommendation** (Phase 2).  
4. **Human Intervention (SSD):** If an Online Qualified user has "Extra Questions" (e.g., specific pricing nuances), the AI triggers a handoff to a **Scaled Sales Development (SSD) rep**.  
   * AI will hand off the customers to the human reps as long as one of the following conditions is met  
     1. AI concierge cannot directly answer questions from users based on existing knowledge base.   
     2. The number of conversation turns between AI and customer exceeds 5 turns.

## **5\. Phased Roadmap**

### **Phase 1: Frictionless Support & Intent Detection**

* **Feature:** Integrated Knowledge Base (RAG).  
* **Requirement:** The VCA must detect "Support Intent" vs. "Sales Intent." Support queries (billing, account access, etc.) must be answered **inline** using an LLM-powered knowledge base lookup.  
* **User Benefit:** Users get their questions answered without ever leaving the "Chooser Page," keeping them one click away from a purchase.

### **Phase 2: Smart Product Recommendations (Online Sales)**

Using a **Unified Propensity Purchase Model**, the VCA will analyze user data (job title, activity, goals) to suggest the ideal SKU.

| Sub-Phase | Feature | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **2a** | **SKU Link Recs** | AI suggests a specific SKU (e.g., Sales Navigator) with a link that redirects the user to that SKU's specific landing page with highest conversion rate. |
| **2b** | **In-Chat SKU UI** | The AI renders a "Product Card" inside the chat. Simultaneously, the background "Chooser Page" UI dynamically updates to highlight the recommended SKU. |
| **2c** | **Memory Agent** | AI leverages historical chat history and real-time platform signals (e.g., hitting a search limit or job changes) to skip the discovery survey entirely. It provides a proactive, high-context recommendation the moment the chat starts |

### **Phase 3: Conversational Commerce (The Closing)**

Transforming the chat from a "help tool" into a "point of sale." Once we completed Phase 2b, we will proceed with direct conversational commerce inside the chat.

| Sub-Phase | Feature | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **3a** | **Link to Checkout** | If the user confirms interest, the AI generates a direct "Fast-Pass" checkout link, bypassing intermediate landing pages. |
| **3b** | **Direct In-Chat Purchase** | Integration with LinkedIn’s payment gateway. Users can confirm their credit card on file and complete the transaction entirely within the VCA bubble. |

## **6\. Metrics**

1. Success metrics,

| Success Metric | Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Total Conversion**  | Total number of AI assisted users who either purchased or started the trial of premium membership within 1D, 7D, 14D,30D after engaging with AI. |
| **Conversion Rate** | % of users who start a Free Trial or Purchase after interacting with the AI concierge within 1D,7D,14D,30D. |
| **Overall Revenue** | Total Premium purchase revenue and total incremental bookings attributed to AI concierge-initiated flows a |
| **Lead Quality** | Number of "Meaningful Field Leads" (MQLs) passed to SD teams that result in a discovery call. \[Long term goal\]Number of high value leads directly passed to AE ( if the infra ready to directly pass leads to AE) |

2. Diagnostic metrics.  
   End to end funnel measurement by surfaces.  
* \# of users click the chat bubble.  
* \# of users have X turn conversations. ( X range from 0 to 10+)  
* \# of users click the recommended SKUs.  
* \# of users  click trial the premium.  
* \# of users complete the transactions.

## **7\. MVP Overview**

Our MVP focus is two-fold: optimizing the **AI sales agent’s conversational flow** to drive conversions and implementing **proactive bubble messaging** to highlight free trial opportunities.

**Target Surfaces:** Survey[https://www.linkedin.com/premium/survey/](https://www.linkedin.com/premium/survey/) and Chooser pages [www.linkedin.com/premium/products](http://www.linkedin.com/premium/products) .

### **Candidate 1: Proactive SKU Recommendations**

**Strategy:** Drive early engagement by offering immediate, data-driven value.

4. **The Flow:** The AI agent surfaces personalized SKU recommendations (via UPM integration) within the initial greeting.  
5. **The Hook:** Messages are tailored to the user’s specific needs, explicitly explaining *why* these recommendations are a fit.  
6. **Conversion Path:** When a user clicks a recommended SKU, they are directed to a pre-checkout page for a seamless, self-service purchase experience.

### **Candidate 2: Consultative Q\&A \+ Guided Conversion**

**Strategy:** Build trust through assistance before transitioning to a sales pitch.

* **The Flow:** The agent opens with a personalized greeting asking how it can assist. It leverages a dedicated sales knowledge tool (similar to search\_knowledge\_base) to answer product-specific queries.  
* **The Hook:** Following a successful Q\&A interaction, the agent provides clear CTAs for SKU recommendations, including free trial links for eligible users.  
* **Conversion Path:** Clicking a recommendation leads the user to a pre-checkout page to complete their transaction.

| Current experience | Proposed experience |
| :---- | :---- |

### **Candidate 3: Proactive Bubble Messaging**

**Strategy:** Test "top-of-funnel" copy variations to increase AI engagement rates.

* **The Flow:** We will A/B test various copy hooks within the chat bubble to prompt users to engage with the AI concierge.  
  * Example messaging copy  
    * ‘Ready to start a free trial?’  
* **The Hook:** Once the user clicks the bubble, the agent triggers the **Proactive SKU Recommendation** flow detailed in Candidate 1\.
